• Metadata storage
Each indexed chunk stores the following information:
• Chunk ID
• Document ID
• Page Number
• Chunk Index
• Chunk Text
• Embedding Vector
The metadata is stored in JSON format while the vector representations are stored
in FAISS index files.
5.15
Retrieval Engine
The retrieval engine identifies the most relevant document chunks corresponding to the
user’s query.
The retrieval process consists of the following steps:
1. Receive User Question
2. Generate Query Embedding
3. Search FAISS Index
4. Compute Cosine Similarity
5. Filter Low Similarity Results
6. Return Top-K Chunks
The retrieval engine supports configurable values for:
• Top-K Retrieval
• Similarity Threshold
• Workspace Filtering
This design significantly improves retrieval accuracy while minimizing irrelevant doc-
ument retrieval.
